amendment_history.reason: The first solver attempt stopped as infeasible under a 0.75 hard monthly-turnover ceiling. No candidate return series, performance metric, or result artifact was produced or inspected.
amendment_history.change: Raised only the hard feasibility ceiling from 0.75 to 1.50; the frozen turnover penalty and stricter acceptance gate requiring turnover no higher than the baseline are unchanged.

amendment_history.reason: A constraint-only audit of the first formation month showed that raw composite-score signs conflicted with the 0.05 size-exposure bound because SIZE is itself a component of the frozen composite. No portfolio return series or performance metric had been produced.
amendment_history.change: Residualize the unchanged composite forecast against lagged beta, log-size, and sector controls before assigning optimizer long/short signs. The original 0.05 size/beta and 0.04 sector bounds remain unchanged. A constraint-only scan found all 179 formation months feasible.

amendment_history.reason: After neutralizing the alpha forecast, a constraint-only sequential scan found that the top-200 membership rule requires up to 1.7012 turnover after inception (95th percentile 1.5787). The 1.50 ceiling was therefore still infeasible. No forward return or performance metric was used.
amendment_history.change: Set the hard monthly-turnover feasibility ceiling to 1.75, just above the measured constraint-only maximum. The optimizer turnover penalty and acceptance gate requiring average turnover no higher than the frozen baseline remain unchanged.

locked_primary_scenario.reporting_classification: retrospective temporal assessment; not a pristine holdout

locked_selection.risk_model: Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage covariance estimated from lagged CRSP daily returns
locked_selection.alpha_forecast: unchanged composite score residualized against lagged beta, log-size, and sector exposures before sign assignment
locked_selection.selection_score: median fold Sharpe at primary costs minus 0.25 times monthly turnover minus 0.25 times absolute maximum drawdown

locked_cost_model.spread: lagged CRSP closing bid/ask; 10% of daily high-low range when missing; two-basis-point floor
locked_cost_model.market_impact: 0.10 times daily volatility times square root of trade dollars over median ADV

acceptance_gates: primary 2021-2024 Sharpe exceeds the frozen baseline over matched dates
paired 12-month moving-block interval for the Sharpe difference excludes zero
average monthly turnover does not exceed the frozen baseline
maximum drawdown is no worse than the frozen baseline
all beta, size, sector, gross, position, and turnover constraints pass
private WRDS security rows remain ignored and absent from committed artifacts
claim_policy: No retrospective outcome, including a high Sharpe, may be called validated alpha. The original future-only 36-month prospective rule is unchanged.
